أتصافح (form VI)
# أَتَصَافَحُ (ʔataṣāfaḥu) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.fa.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# أَتَصَافَحَ (ʔataṣāfaḥa) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.fa.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# أَتَصَافَحْ (ʔataṣāfaḥ) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.faħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
